---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for KeyboardForge
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Component**
Which part would this affect? (`linux/`, `core/`, `cli/`, `gui/`, `packaging/`, `docs/`, or a new one)

**Is this already covered by the roadmap?**
Check `README.md`'s phase table and `docs/architecture.md` first -- if it's
listed under "Future Scope" in the project's scope document, link that
instead of re-describing it.

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the use case.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to happen. If you have an idea of the implementation,
include it -- see `docs/developer-guide.md` for extension points.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.
